title: Top Signal Scores
description: Given an integer array and k, print the k largest values in descending order. Duplicate values are retained.
inputFormat: First line: n and k. Second line: n integers.
outputFormat: Print the k largest values in descending order separated by spaces.
hints: A heap can maintain the most useful candidates while scanning the array.

examples.explanation: The three largest values are 15, 11 and 8.
Duplicate values count separately when selecting the top four.
